Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the eastbound frontage road near a signalized intersection in Sugar Land,
Texas, when the vehicle behind them, operated by Driver 2, failed to stop and struck the rear bumper at a speed that
was clearly more than a light tap. Driver 1 was the operator of the vehicle and was seated behind the wheel at the
time of impact. A Passenger was also in the front seat. Both occupants reported that Driver 1 struck the dashboard
area with the left knee during the collision, and Driver 1 later complained of pain at the scene. Driver 2 acknowledged
that they had looked down at a phone just before the impact and admitted fault. Two independent witnesses in a
nearby vehicle and a pedestrian at the corner each described the sequence in the same way, and photographs taken
at the scene show crushed rear body panels on Driver 2's vehicle and a matching crease in Driver 1's rear bumper.
Responding officers found no prior damage or repair marks on either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured
on the policy covering the struck vehicle. Both vehicles were towed from the scene, and Driver 1 was transported by
ambulance for evaluation.
